name: SLX4 structure-specific endonuclease subunit

function.text: SLX4 encodes structure-specific endonuclease subunit SLX4. Annotated molecular activities include enzyme activator activity. It participates in DNA repair and positive regulation of telomere maintenance.

germline.text: Retained constitutional disease associations include Fanconi anemia complementation group P (autosomal recessive). Pathogenicity and inheritance depend on the specific allele and disorder.

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal recessive; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
